churches.assessment: Bloomington Chapel BIC traces its roots to 1928 when BIC preacher Albert Engle held a successful tent meeting near Columbia, Kentucky — the first BIC outreach in Adair County. The congregation outgrew its original schoolhouse meeting space, moved to a new building in 1960, called its first live-in pastor in 1989, and completed a new 250-275 seat facility in January 2013. Pastor Ralph Foster currently leads. The century-long continuous Anabaptist witness in this rural Kentucky community gives Bloomington Chapel real weight. Yellow rating per denominational caveat; local male leadership and historic accountability give substantial balance.
